items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Because spots he played on, Jelly Roll couldn't play that.

ctx.x: Because spots he played on, Jelly Roll couldn't play that. And I'm not talking to him. I'm not talking to him. I'm talking to all the loud chords. Because he was back there on some good jobs when Tony Jackson and Georgia Thomas and them didn't have nothing to do. Black Pete and all those guys. U. L. Wilson. Albert Cowell. What's this other guy named? Or lived up on Broadway. Alfred Wilson. Alfred Wilson. Oh, yeah.
Yeah. As a king. Yeah. That's all.
